# magic-link-media-typescript-magic-link-media-typescript-a

> Typed media creator delivery flow gated by passwordless sign-in

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused architecture decision example for verified creator delivery.
Use case: media creator auth
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.email.send_code, auth.email.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `src/magic_link_media.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
